plan_item: 77.44.7.D / D-06 — normalize case-insensitive retention UUID cursors before SQLite lookup

finding.bug: The endpoint accepts UUID cursor syntax case-insensitively, but binds the caller-provided spelling into SQLite TEXT equality and keyset ordering. Uppercase characters in a valid UUID therefore made a legitimate cursor appear nonexistent (HTTP 400).
finding.reproduction: A 101-row retention list with one fixed requested_at timestamp yields a valid lowercase page-one cursor; requesting page two with cursor.toUpperCase() returned 400 before the fix.
finding.fix: Normalize the validated cursor with toLowerCase() before both the same-site existence lookup and the keyset query.

regression.test: tests/media-api.test.js — retention status normalizes an uppercase UUID cursor before its site-scoped lookup
assertions: 101 ordered rows split into a 100-row page and a final row when cursor uses uppercase spelling
response remains site-scoped and complete on the final page
D1 row count is unchanged; route remains a read-only GET
